bridges.ranking_rule: Eligible devices sorted by confidence tier (A before B), then by estimated total loss at the evaluation temperature; tier B values are datasheet-point estimates and are not comparable with tier A tensor evaluations

notes: Confidence tiers are never interleaved in the ranking; datasheet-point estimates (tier B) are flagged and not comparable with canonical tensor evaluations (tier A).
Turn-on loss is zero where the waveform satisfies the ZVS current condition; a charge-based verification needs Coss/Eoss evidence.
All evidence is manufacturer model or datasheet data; no laboratory measurement backs any ranking.
